• the number of seconds a plane waits over the airport before it can start to land • the number of seconds it then takes to land.

As soon as the runway is free the plane begins to land.
The number of seconds between one plane and the next plane arriving over the airport is called the inter-arrival time.
The number of seconds from when a plane begins to land and when it stops is called the landing time.
